routingPolicy.title: IMPORTANT — Wave go-live routing
routingPolicy.rule: If a location / region / cluster is Wave go-live (Wave 1 and Wave 2), use ONLY Global Helios Groups for general topics. If it is not go-live yet, continue using the local / legacy groups. SAP topics after Go-Live → assignment group SAP Basis. Clinical Applications always use the local / location IT groups (e.g. KS-IT for Kassel) — Wave go-live does not change Clinical routing.
routingPolicy.shortRule: Go-live (W1+W2) → Global Helios Groups · SAP → SAP Basis · Clinical → always local IT · Pre-wave → local groups
routingPolicy.source: KS-IT (Wave 2 / SAP Basis / Clinical local); T&T - Wolfgardt Bjorn (go-live Global Helios)
routingPolicy.goLiveLabel: GO-LIVE — use ONLY Global Helios Groups
routingPolicy.clinicalNote: Clinical Applications always route to the local / location IT groups (e.g. KS-IT for Kassel), whether the site is pre-wave or Wave go-live. Global Helios Groups do not replace Clinical Applications routing.
routingPolicy.clinicalPreWave: Use local / location Clinical Applications groups
routingPolicy.clinicalPostGoLive: Still use local / location Clinical Applications groups (same as pre-wave)
routingPolicy.clinicalRule: Clinical → local IT group (e.g. KS-IT) — also after Go-Live
